plataforma.titulo: Industrial safety training in virtual reality
plataforma.bajada: Practice a high-risk task in a 360° scene, make the decisions you would make on site and see the real consequence of every mistake. If you pass, you get a certificate anyone can verify.
plataforma.rv_no_disponible: For the virtual reality experience, open this page in the browser of a headset such as Meta Quest.
plataforma.ayuda: Drag to look around. The gas detector is on your left; your progress is on your right. Tap an option to choose it.
plataforma.certificado.demo: Demo certificate: it is stored only in this browser.
plataforma.certificado.error: You passed, but the certificate could not be issued in this browser. Repeat the scenario to try again.
plataforma.sin_certificado: No certificate is issued. You can repeat the scenario at any time.
plataforma.verificar.bajada: Type the code shown on the certificate or in its QR code.

web.portal.proveedor.texto: Offer the platform to your clients under your own brand.
web.portal.operacion.texto: Simulator catalog, headset fleet, licenses and billing.
